import pathlib,json,numpy as np
folder=pathlib.Path('results/ground_contact_v2f_cem_nominal_20261023_v1')
with np.load(folder/'native_comparison_signals.npz',allow_pickle=False) as z:
 rt=z['reference__time_s'];rp=z['reference__position'];rv=z['reference__velocity'];rq=z['reference__quaternion']
 speed=np.linalg.norm(rv[:,:2],axis=1);last=np.flatnonzero(speed>.3)[-1];start=float(rt[last+1]);end=float(rt[-1])
 w,x,y,qz=rq[-1];axis=np.array([1-2*(y*y+qz*qz),2*(x*y+w*qz)]);axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
 rows=[]
 for case in ['original_grounded_baseline','prior_actual_V2a','prior_actual_V2b','prior_actual_V2c','prior_actual_V2d','prior_actual_V2e','actual_V2f']:
  t=z[case+'__time_s'];pos=z[case+'__position'];v=z[case+'__com_velocity'];fz=z[case+'__ground_normal_Fz_n']
  mask=(t>=start-1e-10)&(t<=end+1e-10);idx=np.flatnonzero(mask)[-1];delta=pos[idx,:2]-rp[-1,:2];along=float(delta@axis);cross=float(axis[0]*delta[1]-axis[1]*delta[0])
  rows.append({'case':case,'reference_overlap_end_xy_m':float(np.linalg.norm(delta)),'terminal_ref_heading_along_error_m':along,'terminal_ref_heading_cross_error_m':cross,'actual_speed_at_reference_end_m_s':float(np.linalg.norm(v[idx,:2])),'terminal_low_speed_region_anywheel_support_fraction':float((fz[mask].max(axis=-1)>5).mean()),'terminal_region_actual_mean_speed_m_s':float(np.linalg.norm(v[mask,:2],axis=-1).mean())})
print(json.dumps({'definition':'post-hoc terminal XY decomposition along final reference projected body +X, cross=axis_x*delta_y-axis_y*delta_x; no controller retuning or causal claim','reference_terminal_speed_threshold_m_s':.3,'terminal_region_s':[start,end],'reference_terminal_region_mean_speed_m_s':float(speed[last+1:].mean()),'rows':rows},indent=2))
